messages:
Maya: Quick weekly check-in for Astra Nova — noticed hosted commit usage drift + an anomaly flag this morning. Numbers: committed 1.2M tokens/mo, used 820k so far but yesterday's hourly burn spiked ~3x between 10:00-11:00 PST. Also saw 5xx ratio up ~4% and p95 latency +300ms. OpsBot posted alert at 1769994305. Can someone triage?
Priya: thanks Maya. assigning an owner. is this from batch jobs or interactive usage? :thinking_face:
Ken: finance note — if this keeps up they'll breach commit by mid-month. current run-rate projects ~1.8M tokens. we should consider short-term credits vs throttles. :money_with_wings:
Liam: I can take triage. Maya, do we have sample query of heavy routes? Also can you paste the KV cache hit ratio for their model connections?
Maya: thanks @Liam. quick paste of the hourly burn from our cost table:
```
2026-03-16T09:00Z  38k
2026-03-16T10:00Z  125k  <-- spike
2026-03-16T11:00Z  40k
```
KV cache hit: 12% for that client between 09-12 PST.
Maya: logs show two distinct request patterns: many small completions (~5-10 tokens) and some very long generations (~2k tokens). suspect a bot loop or retry storm. 
Priya: low cache hit + mix of tiny + huge requests points to misconfigured client-side batching or missing streaming ack. Can we run a query to surface top endpoints by tokens and top callers? 
Liam: running quick query now. snippet I'll use:
```
SELECT endpoint, caller_id, sum(tokens) as tokens, count(*) as calls
FROM requests
WHERE customer_id='astra_nova' AND ts >= '2026-03-15'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Liam: results (excerpt):
- /v1/chat/generate — service-worker (internal) — 420k tokens
- /v1/completions — partner-webhook — 310k tokens
- /v1/chat/stream — mobile-app — 90k tokens
Maya: interesting — partner-webhook looks suspicious (third-party integration). priya, can you reach out to their CSM to confirm any recent partner onboarding? 
Priya: yes will ping them. suggested immediate mitigations: set per-route rate cap on partner-webhook to 30r/s, enable prefix caching for the partner's known prompts, and offer a short-term override to protect commit. 
Ken: agree. finance prefers we offer 2 days of protective credits if partner confirms accidental loop. otherwise enforce caps.
OpsBot: AlertSummary: 1769994305 — customer=astra_nova anomaly_type=hosted_spike tokens=125k hour window=10-11 p95_latency_increase=300ms 5xx_rate=4%.
Liam: implemented temporary rate cap on partner-webhook and enabled streaming acks for mobile-app routes. monitoring now. will update in 30m. :eyes:
Maya: thanks. Priya, please coordinate the outreach and offer the 48h credit as Ken suggested if they confirm partner misconfig. Put the meeting on calendar for post-triage.
Priya: done — calendar invite to Astra Nova PM + partner contact for 11:00 PST today. action items in the thread: 1) confirm partner loop 2) validate logs 3) reconcile spend and propose credit if accidental 4) follow-up on caching/quantization recommendations.
Ken: I'll prepare an interim billing note and the credit approval matrix.
Maya: closing the loop — next check-in on this thread after monitoring window. if spike persists escalate to Dedicated team for routing adjustments. :thumbsup:
